## Memory Bench contribution

Describe the dataset, review, adapter, or result change and the evidence that
supports it.

### Scope

- [ ] Code/adapter
- [ ] Dataset scenario or importer
- [ ] Review overlay
- [ ] Live/contract result
- [ ] Documentation/governance

### Required checks

- [ ] I read `benchmarks/memory/CONTRIBUTING.md` and `GOVERNANCE.md`.
- [ ] Every commit includes a DCO `Signed-off-by` line.
- [ ] No credential, personal/private data, downloaded dataset, cache, or
      confidential provider response is included.
- [ ] Dataset sources, exact licenses, changes, and attribution are recorded.
- [ ] AI-authored material is marked `ai` or `mixed` and remains draft until
      independent human review.
- [ ] Corpus-review overlays include a distinct human maintainer-verifier,
      reviewer-identity/conflict affirmations, disposition, and ordered
      timestamps.
- [ ] Published comparisons include a checked, hash-bound paired statistical
      artifact and describe its intervals without ranking/significance claims.
- [ ] Provider affiliation, sponsorship, and other conflicts are disclosed
      below.
- [ ] I ran the relevant build, type, smoke, corpus, review, and release checks.

### Evidence

List commands and exit codes. For a result submission, attach or link the raw
normalized reports, comparison manifest, checksums, dataset version/hash, source
commit, cleanup status, and statistical-comparison artifact.

### Conflicts and affiliations

Write `none` or disclose relevant employer, contractor, investment, advisory,
authorship, and sponsorship relationships.
